subject: Mythology
title: Anansi: The Spider God
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Anansi: The Spider God.

hook.text: Anansi is a tiny spider who outwits gods, kings, and monsters using nothing but cleverness and stories.

buildup.text: He wanted to own all stories in the world. The sky god Nyame said he could — if he captured four impossible creatures.

discovery.text: Anansi trapped a python, a leopard, a swarm of hornets, and a fairy using tricks, not strength.

twist.text: Nyame was so impressed he gave Anansi all the stories. That is why all African folktales are called Anansi stories.

climax.text: Enslaved Africans brought Anansi to the Caribbean and Americas, where he became a symbol of resistance through wit.

punchline.text: The smallest creature in the room owned every story ever told.

quiz.question: How did Anansi win ownership of all stories?
options: He challenged the sky god to a storytelling contest
He captured four impossible creatures using cleverness, not strength
He stole the story box while the sky god was sleeping
